name: Nektar
source:
Saddened by the hardships of life, Amy meets a smiling and energetic butterfly girl Molly in the forest, who asks the guest to spend one day with her. Strangers will have to enjoy the present moment, forgetting about such a concept as «tomorrow».

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966590/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
為生活的艱辛而傷心的艾米，在森林裡遇見了笑容燦爛、活力十足的蝴蝶女孩莫莉。莫莉邀請這位來客陪自己度過一天。兩位素不相識的女孩，將暫時忘記「明天」這個概念，盡情享受當下。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966590/]Steam[/url]]
